svg.desc: A five-stage orchestrator cycle — reap and assess, check in-flight, decide, delegate, monitor and verify — with each component tagged as a deterministic rail (blue) or a swappable-backend agent-role (amber, dashed). RedirectAgent, PromptAgent (dispatch prompts or issue bodies; explicit research-program and repo-audit:phase-4 batch authoring, one backend per batch with per-item role-run evidence), DecomposerAgent, TriageAgent, and AdjudicatorAgent are registered shadow roles; the retrospective adjudicator rail reads trusted merge-bound disputes, records retrospective role runs without changing outcomes, and feeds durability agreement/cost counts to switch review; closer offers require disagreeing recorded verdicts; an accepted RedirectAgent plan is consumed by the deterministic redirect-apply rail, which authorises from recorded state only and stays behind a default-OFF, self-disabling flag; delegated sub-agents run in isolated worktrees (teal); their outcomes feed feedback.py, which relearns both selection weights and role-to-backend fit and returns them to the next cycle. In Decide, the capability advisor is a rail: it answers which of the tool's capabilities apply to the work in hand, narrowing a 40-plus catalogue to the small set declared for the asking surface before ordering that set by measured usefulness. It selects nothing and dispatches nothing. In Monitor and verify, ux_review (Gate 2) supplements the frontend_verify gate with an evidence-bound usability panel — at least four evaluators plus an adversarial critic — whose evaluations and evidence gaps feed feedback.py, and whose per-evaluator fix-hints and coverage gaps are mined by synthesize_improvements into ranked improvement ideas and the next pass's focus. The weekly switch review includes a read-only value-chain rail comparing independent situation counts with production invocations and graded influence outcomes, naming the first broken step and input-off switches without changing gates. Switch review consumes persisted firing findings with separate ledger heartbeat, cadence success-stamp age and artifact time; unknown evidence stays unknown and no finding is auto-cleared. A final band shows the EXTERNAL BOUNDARY: this whole loop is one component of a pipeline whose system-of-record is the Workflows repo — work originates in an approved-issue queue that an opener lane turns into issues and ready PRs, GitHub Actions keepalive drives those PRs to done, and a closer lane merges and verifies. The Orchestrator touches that pipeline through its existing advice, ingest and dispatch surfaces, plus the status-driven local closer: the lanes read capacity.py to pick a review agent, a review-fallback path routes advisory reviews through it, explicit lane verdicts join to keepalive PR runs as versioned capability edges, and its active tick ingests keepalive outcomes, executes opt-in runtime-AC shadow specs on private exact-head disposable checkouts with at most three attempts per ingest and explicit checkout failure reasons, and can apply agent labels when dispatch is enabled. Double-dispatch is prevented by a coarse freshness heartbeat that makes the lanes yield a whole round, not by a per-issue lock. Along the right edge, outside every stage, the tick watchdog is a report-only rail armed before the first step: because a tick that never ends silences everything inside it, it alerts with the exact kill command when one command passes 90 minutes or the tick passes 3 hours of awake time, and it signals nothing itself. The weekly switch-review rail joins closed-issue task-count bands to canonical Brain outcomes and mature fleet-shapes durability, retaining unknown samples and a two-week evidence disposition. A redirect decompose verdict attaches the validated router-chosen shadow DecomposerAgent plan behind the existing role gate and cycle cap, with an explicit deterministic fallback reason; no generated subtask is dispatched by that seam. Runtime acceptance shadow edge: keepalive ingest authors confidence-bearing issue specs; existing Brain completion events feed weekly switch review. Shadow observations grant no merge authority. Switch review reports high-stakes fleet shapes beside label matches; two weekly same-rule match observations mature only the advisor precondition, never review invocation or merge authority. Local delivery delegates credit testgen, codemod and cross-repo lane invocations only after worker launch; the same tags feed versioned Brain influence edges and durability-graded outcomes. The existing TriageAgent also compares an opener priority-search snapshot with the priority/oldest rule each active cycle through triage_shadow, independent of worker dispatch. Its fresh ranking data is consumed only behind default-OFF ORCH_TRIAGE_CONSUME after twenty valid live cycles, retaining every current candidate; selection by the deterministic router is unchanged. Completed downstream runs alone earn version-exact consumption edges. Its observational corpus feeds switch review; replay and unknown durability are unmeasured, and rejected backfill edges never become accepted role credit. The existing codemod rail files format-validated add-only ignore work orders; range rollout accepts only their revalidated campaign targets, behind the unchanged one-off window. Existing Brain outcomes supply attributed durability and cost; unknown evidence stays unknown. The existing Gemini offload rail carries complete evidence through private NDJSON stdin transport instead of shell arguments, preserving model selection and isolation without truncation or acceptance authority. The explicit qualified judgment seam freshly validates the complete first-parent diff, full criterion provenance and owned UNKNOWNs before issuing an opaque in-process semantic input to that same role. JSON cannot issue authority; a private native journal releases only producer-proven unstarted reservations, marks UNKNOWN with the backend ID before invocation and stores raw receipts inside dispatcher before completion effects; callback cleanup scrubs provider logs even on failure, with automatic retries disabled; malformed returned proposals are consumed without stranding recovery; restart projection also requires a fresh opaque collection capability. Canonical native publication reauthenticates cumulative original-case receipts under the shared publication lock and exposes grades through the ordinary summary, preserving every paid identity; generic refresh cannot clobber it. A registered exact-revision private replay can issue fresh execution evidence without changing historical UNKNOWN; equivalent replay metadata cannot purchase another attempt. In-flight provider boundaries, cost, later truth and snapshot authenticity remain separate UNKNOWNs. Redirect Stage-2 credit uses accepted synced outcomes and applied action or worker differences. Failed link rows stay in the existing corpus without stopping later rows. An open gate emits a named-worker supervised-apply dry-run plan and an artifact success heartbeat; live apply remains off. Offline auth, exited and drift fixture replay reaches flag-off authorization without learning or dispatch. The separate retrospective collection rail reads explicitly inventoried git-path acceptance artifacts from the exact evaluated commit, offline and without replacement objects. Byte collection does not prove inventory exhaustiveness or semantic acceptance and never promotes metadata packets or dispatches a role. Explicit case preparation connects complete typed collected bytes to the existing adjudicator input, refusing incomplete or oversized packets and retaining the retrospective evidence floor; preparation itself never dispatches. Durability sweep rechecks issue specs on exact merge commits through the existing runner and completion events, with hash-bound transcripts, idempotent delivery and a dated default-off reopen switch. Unrunnable evidence never reopens or acquires merge authority.Capability consumer declarations name existing file.py:symbol rails; consumer_missing records absent handovers without acting credit or a gate waiver.

The deterministic local closer dispatcher inventories every assigned item. Its production pipeline prepares incremental evidence independently of CI status, routes bounded current-finding classification to any available low-effort profile under fresh capacity, and sends only explicit ambiguous or substantive/security/conflicting cases through the existing closer exception allocation. Each target completion immediately re-enters the existing durable queue with a separate action ledger. Existing target/source/repository claims, capacity and admission, acceptance_ok, exact-head merge guard and native verifier retain authority. Assignment-bound pipeline receipts reject premature stop and retain uncertain operations for reconciliation without replacing a legacy queue receipt. The separately owned source-closure actor remains behind its existing opt-in; this coordinator does not enable it. Shadow mode saves evidence and bounded proposals without worker dispatch or queue actions.

The Orchestrator-owned campaign rail resumes durable workers through a pinned Runtime and Launcher. Workflows owns the closed source/schema Core package. New remote actions use shared GitHub Contents CAS claim and intent fences around existing native guards; local operation stores cannot grant remote authority. Global lane metadata and the real coordinator flock block competing rounds, while target claims and uncertain ledger rows remain item scoped. Fresh configured worker pause policy and independently registered desktop observer evidence are mandatory. Harness and launcher lifecycle receipts cannot promote. The bounded A/B/C wrapper preserves the original deadline and receipt reserve, but the installed cleanup helper lacks a token-safe adapter, so new remote rounds remain held. Packaging and relocation are separate from desktop proof.
svg.title: Orchestrator loop: deterministic rails versus callable agent-roles
svg.desc: After a delegated writer reaches terminal evidence and releases its claim, an available independent provider-family reviewer issues an exact-head advisory verdict. Before a FIX-FIRST re-dispatch, the loop checks current GitHub status and all-head native reservations; queued or absent children remain incumbents until terminal evidence. FIX-FIRST remains non-mergeable and is re-dispatched to the same implementer for at most three review rounds, therefore two re-dispatches; pending, unavailable, failed, and exhausted review remains non-mergeable. MERGE-WHEN-GREEN returns only to ordinary checks. This stage never merges or changes claim ownership.

Muse is an explicit-only subscription backend: implement and review roles declare it as an exploration candidate, while default routing excludes it from ordinary deterministic selection. Private HOME and XDG config/data/cache/state isolate normal personal configuration discovery; only the existing OAuth login record and macOS Keychains directory are aliased. Arbitrary absolute-path reads are not an OS-enforced boundary. Capacity is metered while the immutable profile pool remains flat. Seven-column costs join to muse_subscription_usage with a locally observed five-hour window and unknown provider reset; native Muse JSONL terminal parsing, not MSP, is the accepted form. No provider PASS is claimed.

An independent Poisson-cadence experiment producer feeds tick:experiments with lambda 2/day and a cap of 4 per UTC day. It defaults ON for a self-expiring 21-day trial; dispatch and research-program switches stay OFF. Coverage retests use two non-arm judges and named-test local_verify. Members cannot push through origin; only the exact verified winner is delivered as a ready PR without synthesis. Six merged winners are required to retain the default after the trial; unknowns cannot pass.
svg.text: agent-roles are typed contracts; the model behind each is router-chosen and swappable
svg.title: Opener ranking data: default-OFF ORCH_TRIAGE_CONSUME, 20 valid live cycles, 7200s freshness; deterministic router unchanged; no worker dispatch

g.title: Post-merge supervisor closure rail
g.desc: The existing keepalive-supervisor cadence calls a default-OFF ORCH_SUPERVISOR_CLOSE actor. At most three explicitly linked source issues close per pass, against trusted merge-bound verifier PASS or exact-merge acceptance gates and green CI. Non-PASS or unknown evidence, source holds and changed evidence veto closure. Confirmed closure actions write idempotent runs and outcomes in the existing Brain; redirect apply remains disabled.

g.title: adversarial panel
g.desc: The adversarial review panel belongs to the terminal merge gate (merge_guard): on by default since 2026-10-12, it runs detached right after a high-stakes merge, judged once per exact PR head by one router-chosen reviewer that did not write the change. It is advisory and never blocks; a BLOCKED verdict files one follow-up issue and retries failed source closure independently. The actual squash commit is reviewed while the original PR head remains the memo key; author exclusion, enforced live-state confinement and verified clean restoration precede accepted verdicts. The tick no longer examines closer PRs, which it could never delegate.

g.title: Routing economics: shadow comparative export beside absolute posterior
g.desc: The existing route-weights export rail adds comparative_rank without reordering posterior rankings. The additive orchestrator.route-weights-comparative/v1 block carries lambda opportunity costs, status, pacing observation time and cost provenance. Only measured #668 pool pacing and burn support prices; missing or stale inputs stay null with reasons. Hourly snapshot replay and weekly switch review report classes differing; no hosted consumer or deterministic selection changes.

g.title: Feature goals ledger: daily goal-drift reconciliation and weekly switch review
g.desc: Read-only measures preserve missing evidence as unmeasured, append dated history, classify GOAL_SILENCE_DAYS of observed drift, and reconcile one issue per feature. Measured recovery closes the drift issue; capabilities are never blocked or paused.
